bundle.contents: precomputed, limited-scope model-derived outputs (scores, PCA coordinates, candidate metadata, top-10 context words); not the pretrained embedding vectors
bundle.derived_from: Tshitoyan, V. et al. Unsupervised word embeddings capture latent knowledge from materials science literature. Nature 571, 95-98 (2019). doi:10.1038/s41586-019-1335-8; https://github.com/materialsintelligence/mat2vec
bundle.licence_note: Derived from the pretrained Mat2vec embeddings, whose redistribution terms are unresolved; this bundle's publication status depends on that answer.
